rendered_html: 📔 Regulatory Bulletin — 26 October 2026 (Daily) Executive Summary • 🟡 Hong Kong retail payments: HSBC says its HKD-denominated RedCoin is available on PayMe, creating a live benchmark for stablecoin wallet, merchant-payment and customer-journey design; the announcement does not evidence control effectiveness or impose obligations on other institutions. • 🟡 Canada stablecoin perimeter: the Department of Finance Canada has prepublished proposed regulations, with representations due 23 December 2026; any Canada-facing stablecoin, wallet, custody, PSP or provider exposure warrants a scoped applicability decision. Hong Kong 🟡 HSBC RedCoin launches today 🇭🇰 Item ID: item-20261023-hk-banks-news-aefdef81f0 ⏰ Deadline: No source deadline stated Products: Payments, Digital wallets, Tokenised investments HSBC states that its HKD-denominated RedCoin (RCHKD) became available on PayMe on 23 October 2026. It says PayMe users will be able to activate an in-app stablecoin wallet for peer-to-peer transfers and peer-to-merchant payments at more than 100,000 merchants. HSBC also says it plans later-2026 mobile-app wallet functionality, tokenised-investment subscriptions and wholesale use cases. This product announcement is not an HKMA decision or an obligation for other institutions, but it is a Hong Kong payment and merchant-acceptance benchmark; the announcement does not evidence eligibility, redemption, resilience or operating-control outcomes. Source: HSBC RedCoin launches today SG/UK/GLOBAL Benchmark Comparable overseas developments and commercial/control benchmarks. They do not establish Hong Kong requirements. 🟡 Canada Gazette: Stablecoin Regulations 🇨🇦 Item ID: item-20261024-daily-exploratory-search-ec49ce890c ⏰ Deadline: 23 December 2026 (consultation representations due within 60 days of publication) Products: Payments, Digital assets, Cross-border services Canada’s Department of Finance prepublished proposed Stablecoin Regulations on 24 October 2026, alongside related amendments to the Retail Payment Activities Regulations. The consultation proposes details on issuer registration, one-to-one reserves, redemption, governance, data security, recovery and resolution, reporting and notices, and would bring specified stablecoin payment functions by PSPs into the Canadian framework. Representations are invited within 60 days of publication, and the stated intention is commencement with the Act in fall 2027. This is a Canadian consultation rather than final law or a Hong Kong requirement; it may affect any Canada-facing stablecoin, wallet, custody, PSP or provider operating model, subject to the final scope and exclusions. Source: Canada Gazette, Part I, Volume 160, Number 43: Stablecoin Regulations Watch List • Monitor the published terms for RedCoin wallet eligibility, protections, redemption and planned investment or wholesale features before treating them as current service terms. • Determine whether any Canadian entity, customer-facing activity or provider could be in scope of the proposed Stablecoin Regulations and whether consultation input is warranted by 23 December 2026.
